nina: Quick sync 12pm PT 11 May. We're accepting an external red-team next week; need a compact runbook for evidence handoff + retest gating. Main ask: RBAC delta capture, KMS access pattern, CloudTrail hashes, and a deterministic retest checklist.
farid: I'll draft the RBAC delta script. Plan: record `iam get-account-authorization-details` + generate a normalized CSV of principal,type,resource,privileges and a git commit hash for the snapshot. We'll sign the commit and include the commit SHA in the evidence manifest.
olivia: For KMS, we'll not grant kms:Decrypt to assessor roles. Instead we provide a decrypt-request ticket flow: assessor opens SEC ticket; sec-ops runs decrypt-proxy in controlled VPC that returns an audit blob and, if approved, plaintext via a short-lived secure session. Proxy will log only hashes and request metadata.
sec-bot: [automated] Created SEC ticket SEC-12222: "Red-team evidence handoff & retest checklist" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-12222
oncall-sre: Infra notes: we'll create a temporary bucket `rt-evidence-1815002468` with lifecycle 45d, server-side-encryption SSE-KMS with alias/rt-evidence, and object-lock off. Mirror CloudTrail and VPC flow logs during the window. Presigned uploads expire in 6h.
nina: Minimal manifest fields: `file,path,sha256,sanitized,submitter,commit_sha`. We'll require manifest.csv + cloudtrail-hash.txt + rbac-commit.txt in ticket before retest gate.
farid: Retest gate rules (proposal): 1) zero open Criticals; 2) all Highs either fixed or have a compensating control documented with mitigation ticket; 3) evidence bundle present and checksums match; 4) verification owner assigned. Missing items -> 48h hold.
olivia: Add runtime guard: decrypt-proxy must emit an audit record with `requestor, timestamp, request_id, hmac_of_plaintext`; alert if more than 2 decrypts/hour. We'll also require the proxy code SHA256 stored in ticket.
nina: We'll also capture a pre-window RBAC diff and a post-window RBAC diff so we can prove no privilege escalation happened during the engagement. Farid add that to your script.
farid: On it. Script will output `rbac-diff-before.json`, `rbac-diff-after.json` and `rbac-commit.txt` linking each to a signed git commit.
oncall-sre: I'll add a canary rollback runbook and a killswitch (revoke assessor-role sessions + isolate assessor subnet). We'll rehearse in a tabletop before the event.
nina: Assign owners: farid -> rbac scripts + commit snapshots, olivia -> kms proxy + runbook, oncall-sre -> bucket mirror + canary/rollback, nina -> assessor coordination + final go/no-go. sec-bot please set SEC-12222 assignees accordingly.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-12222 updated: assignees farid, olivia, nina, oncall-sre; due date 2024-05-10
nina: Thanks. We'll do a 24h pre-window check here and attach hashes + manifests to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
